title: myosotis collina var. simplex
intro: Myosotis collina var. simplex, commonly known as Alpine Forget-me-not, is a plant species belonging to the borage family (Boraginaceae). This plant is valued for its potential health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties. The therapeutic actions of Alpine Forget-me-not include soothing digestive issues, reducing anxiety and stress, and supporting respiratory health. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, saponins, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
